subject.title: [Feature] Pre-response enforcement hooks (hard gates) for mandatory tool-call / policy rules

question: Should OpenClaw add a versioned fail-closed pre-response gate API, and what exact validator, retry, fallback, audit, and compatibility semantics should it guarantee?
rationale: This cannot be decided safely by cleanup automation because it changes a security boundary, plugin contract, config surface, and final-delivery behavior rather than fixing a narrow broken code path.

options.title: Design Core Response Gate
options.body: Sponsor a versioned core/plugin response-gate design and require contract tests plus security review before implementation.

options.title: Split Into Narrower Items
options.body: Keep this open as an umbrella but route implementation through narrower issues for tool confirmation, outbound pre-send enforcement, and machine-wide policy loading.

options.title: Plugin-Only Direction
options.body: Decline a core gate and document that policy enforcement must remain in plugin/tool/outbound hooks, accepting that final-response hard gating is unsupported.

recommendation.title: Design Core Response Gate
recommendation.body: Sponsor a versioned core/plugin response-gate design and require contract tests plus security review before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: The closest current hook contracts and runner behavior are in areas recently owned by vincentkoc.
